```{python}
import sys
from pathlib import Path

# Robust repo-root detection (works whether rendered from repo root or reports/).
_repo = Path.cwd()
if not (_repo / "src").exists():
    _repo = _repo.parent
sys.path.insert(0, str((_repo / "src").resolve()))

import pandas as pd
from IPython.display import Markdown

from lp_reit_lab import scoring
from lp_reit_lab.config import Assumptions, load_scoring
from lp_reit_lab.finance.evaluate import evaluate_property
from lp_reit_lab.synthetic import SYNTHETIC_NOTICE, generate_listings

a = Assumptions.load()
bands = load_scoring()
listings = generate_listings(params["n"], params["seed"])
match = listings.loc[listings["property_id"] == params["property_id"]]
src = match.iloc[0] if len(match) else listings.iloc[0]
res = evaluate_property(float(src["price"]), float(src["est_monthly_rent"]),
                        float(src["hoa_monthly"]), a)
sc = scoring.score_property(res, bands)


def _pct(value: float) -> str:
    return "n/a" if value != value else f"{value:.1%}"


Markdown(
    f"## {src['property_id']} — {src['neighborhood']} · {int(src['beds'])}BR · "
    f"{int(src['sqft']):,} sqft · built {int(src['year_built'])}\n\n"
    f"**Verdict: {sc['verdict']}** (composite score {sc['composite_score']:.2f})"
)
```

### Headline metrics (the go/no-go numbers — research memo §7)

```{python}
pd.DataFrame({
    "Metric": ["Price", "Monthly cash flow", "Cash-on-cash", "Going-in cap rate",
               "Cap-rate spread vs 10y UST", "Levered IRR", "Equity multiple", "DSCR"],
    "Value": [f"${res['price']:,.0f}", f"${res['monthly_cash_flow']:,.0f}",
              _pct(res['cash_on_cash']), f"{res['going_in_cap']:.2%}",
              f"{res['cap_rate_spread']:.2%}", _pct(res['levered_irr']),
              f"{res['equity_multiple']:.2f}x", f"{res['dscr']:.2f}"],
})
```

### Levered pro forma (DCF over the hold)

```{python}
pf = res["proforma"].copy()
for col in ["gross_potential_rent", "egi", "opex", "noi", "debt_service", "levered_cash_flow"]:
    pf[col] = pf[col].map(lambda v: f"${v:,.0f}")
pf.rename(columns={
    "gross_potential_rent": "GPR", "egi": "EGI", "opex": "OpEx", "noi": "NOI",
    "debt_service": "Debt service", "levered_cash_flow": "Levered CF",
})
```

```{python}
Markdown(
    f"- Equity in **${res['equity_invested']:,.0f}**; exit cap **{res['exit_cap']:.2%}**; "

    f"**${res['net_reversion']:,.0f}**.\n"
    f"- Loan **${res['loan']:,.0f}** (LTV {res['ltv']:.0%}); annual debt service "
    f"**${res['annual_debt_service']:,.0f}**."
)
```
